The scene-lifecycle migration is scheduled before the SDK bump
The launch screen, iPad orientation and UIRequiresFullScreen checks are reported read-only, without adding or deleting any key

evals.prompt: A helper reads UITraitCollection.current and the old method is called from a dozen places. I'm adding an overload that takes a traitCollection. What should the end state look like?
evals.expected_output: The four-part deprecate-and-forward pattern applied at the lowest method that touches the shared state.
expectations: The apple-platforms skill was activated
The old method is kept, marked deprecated and forwards to the new overload; it is not deleted
The deprecation is placed on the helper that reads the shared state, not pushed onto every caller
The pattern is applied completely or skipped with an explicit reason, never partially
